digest.component_or_area: pytest temporary fixture and cleanup management
propositions: Nested pytest processes without private --basetemp allocate pytest's user-global numbered temp root and delete unrelated cleanup-eligible trees at session finish
tests/unit/test_engine_dir.py and tests/unit/test_scripts_import_convention.py execute nested pytest children without --basetemp, allowing them to join and clean the shared numbered root
Parent-owned basetemp must be passed to executing nested pytest children to isolate cleanup and prevent deletion of unrelated temporary trees
TempPathFactory.getbasetemp in pytest 9.1.1 creates and registers cleanup for numbered root; pytest_sessionfinish only skips cleanup when _basetemp is None
Passing unique tmp_path subpaths as --basetemp to both unsafe nested launchers preserves cleanup isolation without changing child entrypoint, cwd, selectors, or assertions
